payload.description_html: Ceratocaudia is a basal macronarian sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Jurassic Period in what is now India. It may be the earliest macronarian known in the fossil record. Estimated at about 7 m in length, Ceratocaudia is one of the smallest known macronarians, indicating a possibility that it represents a dwarf taxon.
